entries.name: Merge with Shadows
entries: While within {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you can give yourself the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, or a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52}.

entries.name: Shadowy Form
entries: While within {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.
